title: 第5264章 万域缚灵鼎第5263章 金蝉脱壳
lines: 距离黑山洞很远的一处虚空。
十几道身形正聚集在这里，这十几人都是刚才从黑山洞逃出来的弟子。
“好险！”
“刚才那人，实在是太恐怖了，一剑就击溃我黑山洞的防御大阵，并且在众多的长老围攻之下，只一个照面便斩杀了我们宗门的四位长老。”
“此等实力，只怕也就只有我们的洞主才能与之匹敌了。”
“应该是吧，还好对方就只是一个人，并且他虽然在那里大肆破坏，但他似乎并没有对我们这些普通的弟子下手，如此我们才能侥幸逃出来，否则……他要是真的大开杀戒，那我们这些弟子，绝对会死伤无数。”
这些弟子此时都在那里纷纷唏嘘着。
而那个穿着白衣的青年，赫然也在那些弟子之中。
“从黑山洞离开到现在，也过去有一段时间了，若是不出意外黑山洞和幽寒国的那些强者应该已经知道在那里肆意破坏的不过是一尊傀儡。”
江玄坐在那草丛中，脸庞上露出了一抹意味深长的笑容。
通过周围弟子的交谈，他也知晓刚才自己去的宗门名为黑山洞。
而在黑山洞里，他上演了这么一场金蝉脱壳的好戏。
让他之前从秘境里得到的那一尊拥有无敌半步尊主战力的傀儡穿着他的紫袍，戴着紫色面具吸引众人的注意。
而他自己就和黑山洞的那些弟子一块逃离，就此离开了黑山洞，离开了幽寒国所有人的监视范围。
“这还要多亏碎星盟的紫袍、紫色面具特殊，能改变一个人释放出来的气息，否则那些尊主前期强者恐怕一眼便能够看出那不过是一尊傀儡。”
江玄轻笑着。
他相信，自己如今已经脱离幽寒国的监视范围了，之后天高地阔，他想去哪里都可以。
江玄正在那里沉吟着。
突然……
“这位师兄。”
一道淡淡的声音突然响起，那是江玄旁边一个穿着青衣的女弟子朝着他看过来，“看师兄你面生的很，不知道你来自我黑山洞的哪一峰？”
这名青衣女弟子本是闲来没事随口问问，但听到她的话，江玄却不由苦笑一声。
他已经听出来了，黑山洞里应该有好几峰，这代表几个完全不同的派系，但他压根就不是黑山洞的弟子，哪几知道里面有什么峰。
“我嘛，来自蛮峰。”
江玄随意道。
青衣女弟子一怔，周围的那些弟子一下也全都朝他看过来。
“哈哈，看来还是露馅了。”
content_en:
A void far away from the Black Mountain Cave.
More than a dozen figures are gathering here. These dozen people are all disciples who just escaped from the Black Mountain Cave.
"What a risk!"
"That man just now was really terrifying. He defeated my black cave's defensive formation with just one sword. Under the siege of many elders, he killed four elders of our sect with just one encounter."
"With such strength, I'm afraid only our cave master can match it."
"Probably so. Fortunately, the other party was just one person, and although he was wreaking havoc there, he didn't seem to attack ordinary disciples like us, so we could escape by chance. Otherwise...if he really went on a killing spree, we disciples would definitely suffer countless casualties."
These disciples were all lamenting there.
And the young man in white clothes was among those disciples.
"It has been a while since we left the Black Mountain Cave. If nothing else, the strong men in the Black Mountain Cave and the Youhan Country should have known that the person wreaking havoc there was just a puppet."
Jiang Xuan sat in the grass, with a meaningful smile on his face.
Through the conversations with the disciples around him, he also knew that the sect he just went to was called Black Mountain Cave.
And in the black cave, he staged such a wonderful show of a golden cicada escaping from its shell.
Let the puppet he got from the secret realm previously, which has the invincible combat power of the Half-Step Lord, wear his purple robe and purple mask to attract everyone's attention.
And he himself escaped with the disciples from the Black Mountain Cave, leaving the Black Mountain Cave and away from the surveillance range of everyone in Youhan Kingdom.
"This is also thanks to the special purple robe and purple mask of the Broken Star Alliance, which can change the aura released by a person. Otherwise, those early masters might be able to tell at a glance that it is just a puppet."
Jiang Xuan chuckled.
He believes that he is now out of the surveillance range of Youhan Country. From now on, the sky is vast and he can go anywhere he wants.
Jiang Xuan was pondering there.
suddenly...
"This senior brother."
A faint voice suddenly sounded. It was a female disciple in green clothes next to Jiang Xuan who looked towards him, "Senior brother, you look very cool. I wonder which peak of my Black Mountain Cave you come from?"
This female disciple in green was just asking casually when she had nothing to do, but when he heard her words, Jiang Xuan couldn't help but smile bitterly.
He had already heard that there should be several peaks in the Black Mountain Cave, representing several completely different factions, but he was not a disciple of the Black Mountain Cave at all, so how could he know what peaks were inside.
"I am from Manfeng."
Jiang Xuan said casually.
The female disciple in green was startled, and all the disciples around her looked at him.
"Haha, it seems like the secret is still exposed."
